description: Versioned catalogue of the server-sent events a chat turn emits on POST /api/chat_stream and GET /api/chat/resume/{session_id}. Every JSON frame carries the envelope fields; `delta` frames carry no `type`. The literal frame `data: [DONE]` ends the stream. `stability: core` events are typed by sdk/ts and covered by tests/test_sse_catalog.py; `extended` events are passed through by the SDK as UnknownEvent and may change between minor versions.

envelope.sequence: int, 1-based, stable across compaction; pass the last seen value as ?cursor= to resume

headers.X-Odysseus-Run-Id: response header on chat_stream/resume; request header on stop (fencing token)
headers.X-Faustus-Api-Version: server API version on every /api/* response
headers.X-Faustus-Client-Version: optional request header; 426 when below the server floor
headers.X-Faustus-Idempotent-Replay: "1" when a repeated client_message_id re-attached to the existing run

events.name: delta
events.note: text tokens; `thinking` marks reasoning text
answered by the next POST /api/chat_stream: question_id+option_ids/message+revision, or tool_approval_id+tool_approval_decision (approve|approve_task|deny)
also the heartbeat: synthesized after 10 s of silence
clean end of a chat turn
end of an agent turn, failed when `failure` is present
idempotent replay could not find the run but its outbox row is still accepted/running
mid-turn spill/fold under soft context ceiling (tokens_before/after, spilled, overflow_ids)
the user pressed Stop: the turn ends at the top of a round, or between rounds, with stop_reason cancelled
A29: the turn ended because the same call kept returning the same result (stop_reason non_progressing_loop)
advisory (e.g. qwen3.8 long-loop hint); not a turn error

A08/A09: lookup_tools resolution — candidates the index returned, the exact permitted subset promoted for the next round (resolved), and (when resolved is empty) a bounded N=5 closest-by-name/capability fallback
which model actually answered (research/model-switch banners)
per-round provider instrumentation (finish_reason, token counts, sampling settings)
the agent loop hit its round budget
the tool-call budget for this turn was hit
the completion engine's stop/continue decision for this round
repeated tool calls without progress: the stalled tool is hidden and the agent is redirected
a ghost call of a hidden loop-breaker tool was skipped; restored=true means the tool is offered again so later distinct commands can run
harness replaced the in-flight assistant text (e.g. after a check/retry)
teacher-escalation (src/teacher_escalation.py) could not run or did not fix the failure
a stronger model is retrying inline after the turn's own model failed Tier 1/2 evaluation
raw provider stream frame (src/llm_core.py), forwarded verbatim in chat (non-agent) mode
raw provider stream frame: which model a routed/fallback request actually reached
raw provider stream frame: accumulated native tool calls
raw provider stream frame: a streamed native tool-call argument fragment
raw provider stream frame: token usage for the round
timing breakdown of the turn's pre-round setup
explains an automatic model-routing decision for this turn

H4 (src/rewrite_policy.py): write_file refused a repeated whole-file rewrite of the same large, existing file this turn; the model must use edit_file/apply_patch instead. Emitted from the tool-result site of the agent loop.
H5 (src/test_debt.py): one or more pre-existing/exempt tests have stayed exempt for agent_test_debt_turns turns and were injected as high-priority todos into the continue-turn working set.

P1 (src/plan_tracker.py): a plan attachment was parsed/updated or an active plan's brief was injected in place of reinjecting its full body; `current` is the current task's id/key. Emitted by the agent loop integrator, not this lot's own files (see scratchpad/harness_wave/P1_wiring.md).
